title: Battle Hand-Card Skin
description: Semantic source of truth for how cards render in the battle hand: card box geometry, per battle-card-type weapon icon + CGB palette. Element riders are OAM sprites (screens/enemy_types rider_*), not skin icons. The JSON->C compiler emits the const g_card_skin (bank 4) that is staged into WRAM at battle entry. Icons resolve to the fixed VRAM icon tiles ui_init loads (UI_TILE_CARD_* 104-109); colors to UI_COLOR_* palette indices.

w.description: Card box width in tiles. Fixed at 3: the hand lays 5 boxes on a stride-4 column grid (3 box + 1 gap = 20 columns).

h.description: Card box height in tiles (rows). The first interior row carries the weapon icon, the last interior row the power digit; selected-card element riders show as OAM sprites at the battle top-right. cards_row (battle screen hud_layout) is the BOTTOM row; the box occupies cards_row-h+1 .. cards_row.

types.description: Per BattleCardType (src/battle/card.h order SWORD SHIELD BOW HEAL DAGGER).

icon.description: Which VRAM icon tile represents this type/element. Names are the slugified combat-tileset description entries (assets/combat-tileset-description.csv); dagger/ring/amulet have no CSV entry (atlas-only) and keep plain names.

color.description: CGB BG palette index (UI_COLOR_*) applied to the box/icons. On DMG this only affects shade grouping.

uses_icons.description: Optional, at most one card type: remaining-uses floor glyphs, ordered uses 4,3,2,1,0. Slot 4 doubles as the clamp target for uses above 4.

uses_power_icon.description: Optional, same single card type: power glyph drawn on the middle interior row instead of the power digit.
